comment: Reducing repeated diagnostic tests is presented as an expected benefit. Clinicians may still repeat tests because information is outdated, clinically unsuitable, inaccessible, uncertain, or obtained under different quality conditions.

citation.raw: §Lifelong Health Record, 2 p.156 l.Rationale and expected outcomes

anchor.note: p.156 read as the printed page, no line resolved; in the cited section

public.text: Reducing repeated diagnostic tests is presented as an expected benefit. Clinicians may still repeat tests because information is outdated, clinically unsuitable, inaccessible, uncertain, or obtained under different quality conditions.
public.suggestedRevision: Use measured wording and require provenance, timing, method, quality, and clinical-context information so receiving professionals can assess whether previous results are reusable.
